```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from _dashboard_utils import load_validation_results

summary, candidates = load_validation_results()
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Validation Funnel"
funnel = summary["funnel"]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Funnel(
        y=[stage["stage"] for stage in funnel],
        x=[stage["survivors"] for stage in funnel],
        textinfo="value+percent initial",
    )
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Pass Rate per Gate Layer"
layer_columns = ["layer1_pass", "layer2_pass", "layer3_pass", "layer4_pass", "final_pass"]
pass_rates = (candidates[layer_columns].mean() * 100).reset_index()
pass_rates.columns = ["gate", "pass_rate"]

fig = px.bar(pass_rates, x="gate", y="pass_rate", labels={"pass_rate": "% passing"})
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Top Candidates by Net Sharpe"
top_candidates = candidates.sort_values("net_sharpe", ascending=False).head(15)

table_columns = [
    "candidate_id",
    "family",
    "symbol",
    "net_sharpe",
    "net_max_drawdown",
    "net_annual_return",
    "final_pass",
    "failure_reason",
]
display_data = top_candidates[table_columns].round(3)

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Table(
        header=dict(values=list(display_data.columns), align="left"),
        cells=dict(
            values=[display_data[column] for column in display_data.columns],
            align="left",
        ),
    )
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0))
fig.show()
```
